**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement imposes no audit, inspection, records-examination or usage-verification obligation on Mortgage Logic.com as Client:

- Searches for *audit*, *inspect*, *records*, *verif*, *books*, *monitor* return no hits.
- **§ 5–6 (Compensation / Documentation and Disputes)** runs in our favour — TrueLink must supply supporting documentation on request and we may contest charges.
- **§ 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client)** contains only compliance, access-restriction and content warranties; no examination right. § 8(f) lets TrueLink implement technical anti-spam mechanisms on its own systems, which is not an audit of or access to Client systems.

Because the complete absence of an audit right is better for us than the preferred position, there is nothing to limit and no redline is warranted — proposing audit parameters would only invite an audit right into the deal. If TrueLink later seeks fee or usage verification, we would then insert the playbook limits (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, independent auditor under confidentiality, Vendor cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, no direct system access).
